Nasdaq Hits Record High Amid AI Stock Rally

The Nasdaq Composite index closed at a record high, driven by a rally in artificial intelligence (AI) stocks. The tech-heavy index recovered from a summer sell-off, with investor enthusiasm for AI contributing to the surge. Top tech investor Dan Niles discussed the Nasdaq's record close.
